title: Lot-Size Scale for Self-Help Visits — Community Rules & Site Care Rate Card Annex
content:
For lawn and snow cures under Community Rules & Site Care, the contract visit rate is scaled by the lot class named on the Home-Site Lease. A debris cure, or a cure on a single-section lot, is not scaled for lot size.

| Lot class on the Home-Site Lease | Lawn and landscaping cure, or snow and ice cure | Debris and storage cure |
|---|---|---|
| Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site | multiplied by 1.8 | not scaled |
| Greenbelt Multi-Section Home Site | multiplied by 1.8 | not scaled |
| Standard Multi-Section Home Site | multiplied by 1.4 | not scaled |
| Preferred Multi-Section Home Site | multiplied by 1.4 | not scaled |
| a single-section lot | not scaled | not scaled |

## Hypothetical illustration

A visit rate of $60.00, chosen for illustration:

- a lawn cure on a Greenbelt Multi-Section Home Site: $60.00 multiplied by 1.8, which is $108.00;
- a snow cure on a Standard Multi-Section Home Site: $60.00 multiplied by 1.4, which is $84.00;
- a debris cure on a Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site: $60.00, not scaled;
- a lawn cure on a single-section lot: $60.00, not scaled.
